summary: Build a website matching the look and functionality of https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and deliver the complete output.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Abstract hero illustration with geometric shapes, modern corporate style (hero-illustration.dim_1600x900.png)
- Row of 6 generic partner logos in monochrome style (partner-logos-strip.dim_1600x200.png)
- Set of 6 simple outline feature icons (feature-icons-set.dim_1024x1024.png)
- Testimonial portrait placeholders (3 headshots, neutral background) (testimonials-headshots.dim_900x300.png)
- OpenGraph preview image with abstract shapes and title-safe area (og-image.dim_1200x630.png)

existing_features.title: Build a multi-page marketing website that closely matches the information architecture and UX patterns of https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ (header navigation, homepage sections, inner pages, footer), using original copy and assets (no proprietary text/images copied from the reference site).

Implement the homepage with clear, scroll-based sections comparable to the reference site’s homepage (hero, social proof, feature/value sections, benefits, testimonials/case studies preview, resources preview, and final CTA band), including appropriate spacing, typography hierarchy, and section transitions.

Create a Resources area that supports listing content cards and viewing a content detail page, with client-side routing and consistent templates (title, summary, cover image, body content, author/date, and related items).
Add a Contact page with a form (name, email, company/organization, message) and clear success/error states. Persist form submissions in the Motoko backend and expose a read API for later retrieval.

Implement site-wide UI polish similar to the reference site: consistent section widths, large-type marketing typography, hover/focus states, accessible contrast, and light motion (e.g., subtle fade/slide-in on scroll) without harming performance.

Apply a creative, coherent visual theme suitable for a modern B2B strategy/software marketing site (avoid a blue/purple-dominant palette). Define and use a consistent system for colors, typography, buttons, cards, and section backgrounds across all pages.
Add basic SEO and social metadata for all primary routes (title, description, OpenGraph image) and ensure accessible semantics (landmarks, headings, alt text for images).
Deliver the complete runnable project output (frontend + Motoko backend) so the site can be built and deployed as-is on the Internet Computer template environment.
